_edit: Edit each release: version is the release number (csproj <Version>), 2 to 4 items. title says what it is, how says where to click to try it now. icon is one of sparkles, armchair, activity, link, book-open, rocket, box, camera, git-compare (Lucide).

items.title: View picker
items.how: Tap the cube at the top left of the Forsk window for Perspective, Plan or an elevation.

items.title: Jump inside
items.how: Click a room's floor, then More actions → Jump inside. The view shows the materials and is saved after the room.

items.title: Saved options
items.how: Analyses menu → Options: save the model as option A, B, …, then compare or restore it.
